description: Substrings that appear in the SMBIOS-derived strings of virtual machines (system manufacturer and model, baseboard, BIOS). Matched as a case-insensitive substring against Win32_ComputerSystem, Win32_BaseBoard and Win32_BIOS properties. A match makes the environment.virtual_machine row report this display name; no name is in code. Properties are documented by Microsoft; the marker values are community-reported and were not re-verified on a virtual machine (the reference bench is physical), so none is marked observed.

entries.source: https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/cimwin32prov/win32-computersystem (Model is a documented property; the value is community-reported)
entries.notes: Also used by Windows Sandbox and by cloud services built on Hyper-V. The manufacturer alone is not a marker because physical machines can carry the same manufacturer string.

entries.source: https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/cimwin32prov/win32-computersystem (Manufacturer and Model are documented properties; the values are community-reported)
entries.notes: Model strings reported include 'VMware Virtual Platform' and 'VMware7,1'; the manufacturer string reported contains a comma, which is why the marker is only the product word.

entries.notes: Covers guests of libvirt, Proxmox and similar tools that use QEMU's default SMBIOS strings; a host that overrides those strings is not recognised by this entry.

entries.notes: The marker 'Xen' is a substring test, so an unrelated physical product name that merely begins with those letters would also match; such a case blocks optimize mode (the safe direction) and can be fixed by editing this entry.
